quotes.speaker: T.J. McConnell
quotes.summary_phrase: T.J. McConnell on how fatherhood changed his perspective on basketball
quotes.excerpt: When you have kids, your perspective changes that at the end of the day, it's just a game.
quotes.quote: Before kids, if I would play bad, I would fester on it so much longer. But when I come home, whether I play good or play bad, their attitudes don't change how they feel about me. It's like, I love you, you can't really explain until you have kids. You walk through the door and you had a bad game and you got two kids running into your arms saying I love you, it changes your whole perspective.
